persona: Mid-level inventory analyst with a few gaps
resumeText:
Arjun Nair | Chennai | arjun.nair@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Inventory Analyst, Coromandel Home Appliances Pvt Ltd, Chennai (2023 - present)
- Track stock for 2,500 SKUs and set safety stock and reorder points for 12 warehouses.
- Built a monthly SKU-level demand forecast using moving averages and tracked forecast accuracy by region.
- Pull stock, purchase order and goods receipt data from SAP for daily planning reports.
- Write SQL queries on the sales data warehouse to compare dispatches with orders.
- Built a Power BI dashboard on inventory ageing and stock cover for the planning head.

MIS Executive, Marina Consumer Durables Pvt Ltd, Chennai (2021 - 2023)
- Maintain the weekly replenishment plan in Excel with VLOOKUP and pivot tables.
- Shared daily dispatch summaries with the warehouse and sales teams.

EDUCATION
BE Mechanical Engineering, Anna University, 2021

SKILLS
SAP, Excel, SQL, Power BI, OTIF reporting
